headline: Dark Alphas Team
title: One Team for Three Dark Alphas | Wind and Light | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Here is one team that beats three Alphas. Alpha Stellarys, Alpha Ignitis and Alpha Rookey are all Dark bosses, and all three are weak to Wind and Light. Stellarys is in the Forest of Falling Stars, Ignitis in Berylline Vale, and Rookey in Russet Highlands. Bring a Wind Aniimo, a Light Aniimo, a Breaker and a healer, and you are ready for all of them. Which Alpha first? Comment below!
description: One Aniimo team for three Dark Alphas: Stellarys, Ignitis and Rookey are all weak to Wind and Light. Bring Wind and Light damage dealers plus a Breaker and healer.
